# AXe simulator driver

Version: 1.8.0. Upstream: https://github.com/cameroncooke/AXe/tree/v1.8.0

Official universal archive: `AXe-macOS-v1.8.0-universal.tar.gz`

SHA-256: `7b76340b72e90d0f211bc7c4636f15009076eff07acef2f2b632b175debd8834`

The runtime downloads the official archive into its private cache when an iOS simulator is selected. It retains the packaged frameworks beside the executable. `LICENSE` and `THIRD_PARTY_LICENSES` are copied unchanged from the pinned upstream tag. No upstream Swift implementation is copied into this package.
